name: Miharu (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Miharu town emblem in red: a disc crossed by a stylised character of diagonal strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Miharu, a town in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 3 November 1958.

features.role: Miharu town emblem — a disc crossed by a stylised character of diagonal strokes
